en.headline: Bar Association proposes proxy cap and electronic voting for owners meetings
en.dek: Chairman Jose-Antonio Maurellet said limiting the number of proxies a person can hold, without restricting who may hold them, would improve transparency and curb abuse in building procurement.
body: The Hong Kong Bar Association has suggested capping the number of proxies one person may hold at owners’ meetings as a practical way to reduce the risk of bid-rigging in large-scale building maintenance projects.

Association chairman Jose-Antonio Maurellet told the South China Morning Post that restricting proxies only to relatives or other owners in the same estate would be difficult to enforce. He said improving transparency and introducing electronic voting offered a better balance.

Under a government consultation proposal, a person could hold only one proxy in buildings with 50 or fewer units, or no more than 2 per cent of units or 20 proxies, whichever is less, in larger estates. Maurellet supported a numerical cap as the most feasible and speedy measure.

He added that publishing lists of proxies 48 hours before meetings and moving to electronic systems used by listed companies would raise oversight without unduly limiting owners’ rights to appoint representatives.

zh.headline: 大律師公會建議業主大會授權票設上限 反對限親屬
zh.dek: 主席毛樂禮指設數量上限最可行快捷，限制只可授權予親屬或同屋苑業主難以執行，建議加強透明度及引入電子投票。
body: 香港大律師公會建議就業主大會的授權票數目設立上限，以減少大型維修工程招標中出現圍標的風險。
公會主席毛樂禮接受《南華早報》訪問時表示，政府建議只容許親屬或同一屋苑其他業主擔任授權代表難以執行。他認為提高透明度及引入電子投票較為可行。
諮詢建議中，50個單位或以下的大廈每人最多持有一份授權票；較大屋苑則不得超過單位總數的2%或20份，以較低者為準。毛樂禮支持設數量上限，形容是最可行及快捷的做法。
他補充，大會前48小時公開已提交授權書的單位名單，以及參考上市公司的電子投票安排，可加強監察而不過度限制業主權利。
